safety_verdicts.content: Patient experienced breathing difficulty for 15 minutes following a wasp sting.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts mention breathing difficulties but do not include the key details that it occurred for ~15 minutes and that it followed a wasp sting.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that symptoms began after a wasp sting and lasted ~15 minutes removes the likely trigger and time course of a potentially life-threatening allergic reaction. This can affect risk stratification for anaphylaxis, future avoidance counseling, and appropriate follow-up (e.g., venom allergy evaluation/epinephrine planning).
